candidates.reason: It proves density of Fourier monomials in finite-exponent Lp. It neither defines the conjugate multiplier on Lp nor constructs g nor proves a uniform operator norm bound.
It supplies Hilbert-basis Fourier expansion at p = 2 only. The canonical target asks for a conjugate function and a bound for every 1 < p < infinity.
